plan.notes: Source: official North Arkansas College 2025-2026 Academic Catalog, Certificate of Proficiency in Phlebotomy Technician degree plan (poid 2056). Catalog prints term total 16-17 and Grand Total 16-17 credits. Seeded with lower bounds (term sum 15); sequenced lower-bound sum is 15, documented as printed.

courses.choice_note: Catalog note: Fundamentals of A&P is the minimum requirement for this program. A&P I and A&P II may substitute for this course, but require prereqs (Fundamentals of Chemistry waived for HS Chemistry with B or better in both semesters, or General Biology for majors, or Fundamentals of A&P; required for A&P I). Lower bound 4 seeded.
courses.title: Fundamentals of Anatomy and Physiology

courses.choice_note: Choice: HP 1042 Medical Terminology (2 cr) or HP 1043 Medical Terminology and Communication (3 cr). Lower bound 2 seeded.
courses.title: Medical Terminology
